verdict.rationale: Sentry documents Seer, an autonomous debugging/code-review agent that runs in the background to catch and fix issues, plus Autofix and alert/webhook automations that fire without manual intervention. However, evidence is entirely first-party marketing/docs with no independent confirmation of true unattended, scheduled automations, and Seer requires a paid subscription, limiting full agentic autonomy for all users. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of autonomous run behavior, detail on scheduling/triggering configuration for background automations, and confirmation this works outside the paid tier.
